last_result.headline: N1 negative. The geometry band binds 83-91% of transitions but does not improve the DP: on 40 eval wells the unbounded control wins (12.518) and a 12-well apparent 25% gain (9.412) vanished (15.569). Nested 2-fold selection gives DP 13.644 vs flat-anchor 12.722 - does not beat flat. This also AMENDS G3.2 from earlier today: its "DP beats flat" selected lam on the reported wells and does not survive nesting; the scorer AUC 0.7242 vs NCC 0.5010 still stands. Band buys stability, not accuracy.
